metadata.question: Is the Kalahari Desert greener on April 19, 2009 compared to August 6, 2008, based on NDVI measurements?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Compare NDVI between two specific dates (2008-08-06 and 2009-04-19) - Use Sentinel-2 first, but these dates are before Sentinel-2 launch (2015), so use Landsat - Landsat 5 or 7 would be available for these dates - Kalahari Desert spans Botswana, Namibia, and South Africa (approximately -20°S to -28°S, 20°E to 26°E) 2. Masking strategy: - Should mask clouds since we want valid NDVI measurements - Use cloud masking for Landsat (QA_PIXEL band) 3. Logic: - Valid Zero: NDVI can be low (near 0) for desert, which is valid - Null/Error: No images found (C1), no valid pixels after masking (C2), or invalid NDVI values (C3) - Compare mean NDVI: if 2009-04 > 2008-08, then greener (A), else (B) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Kalahari Desert region (approximate center and bounds) const kalahari = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[20, -20], [26, -20], [26, -28], [20, -28], [20, -20]] ]); // 2. Function to mask clouds in Landsat function maskL457Clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0) // Cloud .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)); // Cloud shadow return image.updateMask(cloudMask); } // 3. Function to calculate NDVI function addNDVI(image) { const ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B4', 'SR_B3']).rename('NDVI'); return image.addBands(ndvi); } // 4. Get Landsat data for August 6, 2008 let col2008 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(kalahari) .filterDate('2008-08-01', '2008-08-15') .map(maskL457Clouds) .map(addNDVI); const size2008 = col2008.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2008-08 Images found: ${size2008}`); if (size2008 === 0) { console.log('No data for August 2008'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 5. Get Landsat data for April 19, 2009 let col2009 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(kalahari) .filterDate('2009-04-15', '2009-04-25') .map(maskL457Clouds) .map(addNDVI); const size2009 = col2009.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2009-04 Images found: ${size2009}`); if (size2009 === 0) { console.log('No data for April 2009'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 6. Create median composites const img2008 = col2008.median(); const img2009 = col2009.median(); // 7. Calculate statistics for 2008 const stats2008 = img2008.select('NDVI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: kalahari, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const ndvi2008 = stats2008['NDVI_mean']; const count2008 = stats2008['NDVI_count']; console.log(`2008-08: NDVI=${ndvi2008 ? ndvi2008.toFixed(3) : 'null'}, Pixels=${count2008 || 0}`); if (!count2008 || count2008 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels for 2008'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 8. Calculate statistics for 2009 const stats2009 = img2009.select('NDVI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: kalahari, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const ndvi2009 = stats2009['NDVI_mean']; const count2009 = stats2009['NDVI_count']; console.log(`2009-04: NDVI=${ndvi2009 ? ndvi2009.toFixed(3) : 'null'}, Pixels=${count2009 || 0}`); if (!count2009 || count2009 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels for 2009'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 9. Validate NDVI values if (ndvi2008 === null || ndvi2009 === null || isNaN(ndvi2008) || isNaN(ndvi2009) || ndvi2008 < -1 || ndvi2008 > 1 || ndvi2009 < -1 || ndvi2009 > 1) { console.log('Invalid NDVI values'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 10. Compare NDVI values const difference = ndvi2009 - ndvi2008; console.log(`NDVI Difference (2009 - 2008): ${difference.toFixed(3)}`); if (ndvi2009 > ndvi2008) { console.log('Kalahari was greener in April 2009'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Kalahari was NOT greener in April 2009'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
